title: GitHub Investigating TeamPCP Claimed Breach of ~4,000 Internal Repositories
summary: GitHub on Tuesday said it's investigating unauthorized access to its internal repositories after the notorious threat actor known as TeamPCP listed the platform's source code and internal organizations for sale on a cybercrime forum.
